offer.name: Group Booking Conversion Microflow
offer.proposition: A lightweight mobile-first group/private booking intake layer that preserves existing ticketing while capturing structured group/date/accessibility/contact requirements, acknowledging enquiries, and routing them to the existing team.

outreach.problem_basis: Group/education bookings are not available in the standard online flow and require separate contact.
Group bookings are handled by phone/email/contact.
outreach.response_summary: They are happy with the way they currently process bookings.
outreach.learning: Disqualify the proposed booking-friction problem for Cork City Gaol; do not pursue or send a follow-up. This target-level result does not falsify the broader cluster.

outreach.problem_basis: Group tours are routed to Visitor Centre phone/email rather than standard public tour booking.
Private/group-style enquiries use separate phone/inquiry handling despite online standard bookings.
Group bookings are handled through phone/email while standard tickets are online.

truth_boundary.gmail_SENT: proves AMX submitted the messages to Gmail's sent path; it does not prove recipient delivery or reading.
truth_boundary.cork_reply: proves Cork received the proposition and explicitly rejected the problem hypothesis for its own process.
truth_boundary.delivery: Cork confirmed by reply; four other recipients remain unproven; no matching bounce notices were found.

next_action: Do not contact Cork again. Monitor Dublin Zoo, National Botanic Gardens, Dubai Dolphinarium and The Everyman for bounce or substantive reply. Preserve silence as pending until the bounded follow-up window; then use one non-generic, value-adding follow-up or close the target. Continue weighted discovery for stronger clusters in parallel.

learning_update.rationale: One explicit target-level rejection is real evidence but is insufficient to universalize across five independently observed problem instances.
learning_update.falsifier: Broad cluster should be weakened or killed only after repeated target-level rejection/absence evidence across a sufficient bounded sample.
